plain: Whether an existing privacy rule is actually justified, not just customary.
eli5: A rule is fair only if it helps everyone and fits what the place is for, not just because it has always been that way.
technical: In contextual integrity, an entrenched norm is presumed but not guaranteed legitimate; it is justified if it fairly balances the interests of affected parties, fits ethical and political principles, and serves the context's own ends and values, so a better-serving alternative can override it.
